**SLACK PARTNER PROGRAM**

# **Build what’s next.** **Partner with Slack.**

Join the technology companies and implementation experts helping teams move faster, work smarter, and do more where AI and agents work.

## Slack is the platform agents call home

With thousands of apps and agents in the Slack Marketplace and a platform purpose-built for agentic development, Slack gives partners real reach — and the infrastructure to match.

- **2,600+**

  apps and agents in the Slack Marketplace
- **1.7M**

  apps used weekly
- **690%**

  YoY growth in AI-enabled app creation

## Ways to partner with Slack

- ### ISV and Technology Partners

  Build agents and apps that reach enterprise teams where they're already working. List on the Slack Marketplace and get platform access, partner benefits, and go-to-market support that grow with you.
- ### Consulting and SI Partners

  Help customers roll out and expand Slack across their organizations. Consulting partnerships are managed through the Salesforce Partner Community.

## The more you build, the more the program invests

The Slack ISV Partner Program gives technology companies a clear path for building and growing on Slack. As you build in Slack, the partner program will invest back in you.

- ### Developer

  Build custom apps for your team and learn the platform. Get access to developer sandboxes, our core APIs, and the full developer toolkit.
- ### Marketplace Partner

  List your app and get discovered. Plus, get access to the partner community, roadmap visibility, a partner badge, and partner webinars.
- ### Agent Partner

  Everything in Marketplace Partner, plus co-marketing, partner betas, event and advisory board access, and dedicated partner manager support for Salesforce-aligned partners. Top-tier partners get early access to advanced agentic capabilities.

**SLACK PLATFORM**

## **M****eet your customers where they’re already working**

Slack’s platform lets you bring your product to where teams are already working, without starting from scratch. Add existing apps and agents to Slack and connect them to the conversation, making your product more accessible and embedded in everyday workflows.

**DEVELOPER TOOLS**

## **B****uild with no code, or pro code**

Build agents that work alongside teams. Automate workflows that span tools. Connect your product directly into the conversations where decisions get made. Slack gives you everything from no-code building blocks to pro-code primitives, and soon you’ll be able to connect your agent to Slackbot itself.

## Already a Salesforce ISV partner?

Your Salesforce integration already meets customers where they work. Slack is the next place. List on the Slack Marketplace and join the ISV Partner Program for co-marketing, go-to-market support, and the same benefits available to all our technology partners.

## Frequently asked questions

Your partnership with Slack includes benefits designed to help you build, grow, and sell your solutions with speed and scale. We have tools that make it easy to bring your solutions to Slack without starting from zero and as you build deeper in Slack, you unlock access to premium platform capabilities and co-marketing opportunities to amplify your impact and reach.

The Slack Platform has been reimagined for the agentic era — giving developers pre-built building blocks, flexible primitives, and a simplified developer toolkit so you never have to start from zero. With tools like the Slack CLI, Bolt, Block Kit and Slack MCP server already at your fingertips, you can ship AI-powered apps and agents in minutes, not months.

Slack has more than 1.7M apps used on our platform every week and our customers love us. With your solutions deployed on the Slack platform you instantly reach the 200k+ paid customers using Slack every day through the Slack Marketplace driving immediate customer value. As your partnership with us grows, you can also gain access to co-marketing opportunities to further grow your business.

Partnering with Slack means attaching your brand to one of the most trusted and beloved platforms in the world — used by millions across every industry. That association instantly signals to your customers that your product meets the highest standards for security, reliability, and user experience. With Slack’s built-in user base already deeply embedded in their daily workflows, a Slack partnership doesn’t just add credibility — it puts you in front of the right people at the right time.

We offer access to all of our Slack APIs and integration patterns for free to partners.

You get comprehensive support and resources to scale your business. This includes a powerful community of over 20 million Trailblazers, 20k Slack Community members and your peers in the Partner Blazer community.

You can start by joining the Salesforce Partner Community. The Salesforce partner program offers comprehensive benefits to drive customer success and your company’s growth.
